audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart says 'Skill' on rows 2-4 and 2+ items while content and packet say Swain wins level 2, Lissandra wins 3 through 6, and Swain takes over at two-plus items; phases[4].why also described Swain inviting the dive while its own side says Lissandra.
audit.why: Her 24s Glacial Path is not online for the level-2 window, dodges Nevermove from 3 onward, and self-cast Frozen Tomb plus Zhonya's wins the 6 duel; late, a drain-tank outlasts her and her point-blank R walks into your E.

audit.why: Spikes correctly frame her 3-5 window, her 6 tomb duel, the first-item skill stretch, and your two-item takeover.
